notation: Logical Arabic in the engine notation (engines.alttp_arabic): a line for each page of the message, {line} where a line must end; the encoder breaks the other lines itself, a page holding three lines, and the game waits for the button between pages. {Name} writes the player's name as the player gave it, in Latin letters; a line counts 42 pixels for it. {Window 02}, {Speed 03}, {Wait 01}, {Sound 2D}, {Color 02} and {Number 00} pass to the game as the English has them. A message holds Arabic letters, spaces, Western or Arabic-Indic digits and the punctuation . , : ! - … ، ؛ ؟ only. No vowel marks: the font has none.

entries.context: Link's uncle, leaving the house at night: he will be back by morning, and Link must stay in ({Name} is the player's name)
entries.text: {Name}، سأخرج لبعض الوقت.{line}سأعود في الصباح.{line}لا تغادر البيت.

entries.context: Zelda calls to Link in his sleep, in the window without a frame, slowly: she is a prisoner in the castle's dungeon, the wizard has taken the other girls and seized the castle to break the seal of the seven wise men
entries.text:
{Window 02}{Speed 03}ساعدني…{Wait 01}{line}{line}أرجوك ساعدني…
أنا سجينة في زنزانة القلعة.{line}اسمي زيلدا.
لقد فعل الساحر أغانيم شيئا بالفتيات المفقودات، ولم يبق غيري…
استولى أغانيم على القلعة، وهو يحاول الآن فتح ختم الحكماء السبعة…
أنا في زنزانة القلعة.
أرجوك ساعدني…

entries.context: The chest in Link's house: he gets the lamp, which lights torches and shows the way in the dark
entries.text: حصلت على المصباح!{line}يمكنك الآن إشعال المشاعل{line}ورؤية طريقك في الظلام.
